
## Anti-Patterns to Avoid

- ❌ **Don't** reference Infrastructure directly from Presentation
- ❌ **Don't** put business logic in Controllers or Pages
- ❌ **Don't** use exceptions for control flow
- ❌ **Don't** expose Entity Framework entities in API responses
- ❌ **Don't** skip validation on commands
- ❌ **Don't** mix synchronous and asynchronous patterns
- ❌ **Don't** forget to register services in DI container
